description: Published answers of Vargov®Design about ordering, production time, delivery, installation, certification, warranty, the configurator, BIM/IFC, colours and finishes, with the pages they come from. Answers are matched by the words of the question, not by meaning: up to three candidates, best word match first; found=false when the question shares too few words with the published answers. When the project's country is in an official dealer's region (outside Russia and the CIS), each answer text ends with a line naming that dealer and its contacts. A question about stock that names one LC code also returns stock: the elements of that composition in stock. Works best with the question in English or Russian; lang sets the answer language (English where no translation exists).

country.description: Optional: country or city of the project (e.g. UAE, Dubai, Vietnam). contact is then the official dealer for that region (Russia and the CIS: the brand); brandContact always holds the brand's own contacts.

lang.description: Language of the result: ru, en, de, it, fr, es, vi or ar. Default en.

question.description: The question, preferably in English or Russian.

name: ask_brand
title: Verified brand answers
